title: Replace vs repair, then drill in
intent_mechanism: coreference ('the replacements'), long-range to turn-1 set
gold_orchestration: P: count(Replace)||count(Repair); S: filter Replace -> group_count(object_class) -> rank3
weak_agent_trap: agent re-runs everything or forgets the 'change out' clarification when ranking

title: Leaks chat interlude
intent_mechanism: coreference ('those','the worst') back to leak set
gold_orchestration: S: search(leak)->set; on SET: count(seal)||count(replace); rank(object_class)
weak_agent_trap: agent re-searches leaks each turn instead of reusing the set; ignores chat and loses thread

title: Two components in parallel
intent_mechanism: long-range: extend the same comparison frame
gold_orchestration: P: extract(bearing)||extract(seal); compare; later P add belt -> 3-way
weak_agent_trap: agent does sequential one-by-one (suboptimal path) or drops the original two when adding belts

title: Vague then precise
gold_orchestration: S: rank(object_class by fault) -> top; then top_remedy(filter=top)
weak_agent_trap: agent answers before the clarification, or 'it' rebinds to the wrong component

title: Inspection effectiveness, branching follow-ups
gold_orchestration: search(Inspect)->set; count(fault in set); group_count(object_class); rank ascending by yield
weak_agent_trap: agent recomputes inspection set; mis-defines 'wasted' (low yield) as low count

title: Spares list with a detour
gold_orchestration: rank10(Replace patient); for those10 P: split failed vs routine; filter failed
weak_agent_trap: agent re-ranks or applies the failed/routine split to ALL components, not the ten

title: Pump deep-dive, identity clarify
instruction_transition: clarify to override the misleading asset tag
gold_orchestration: search(text mentions pump) NOT tag; extract faults+remedies
weak_agent_trap: agent groups by the fabricated PMP tag (wrong) instead of the text

title: Failure-mode pareto, then one slice
intent_mechanism: long-range: top mode feeds the last turn
instruction_transition: pure task chain (no chat) but deep dependency
gold_orchestration: group_count(fault); cumulative-to-80; filter top -> group_count(object_class)
weak_agent_trap: agent loses the 'top mode' referent or recomputes pareto each turn

title: Parallel two-sites mental model (trap)
instruction_transition: user self-corrects an impossible ask mid-stream
gold_orchestration: recognise no shift field -> abstain on shift; pivot to group_count(object_class, fault)
weak_agent_trap: agent fabricates a shift split, or gets stuck instead of pivoting

title: Bearings then 'the same for'
intent_mechanism: partial intent: 'same for X' inherits the metric
gold_orchestration: P: count(Replace&bearing)||count(Replace&seal)||count(Replace&belt) -> table
weak_agent_trap: agent fails to infer the elided metric, or serialises avoidably (poor Optimal Path)

title: Chat-heavy, buried task
instruction_transition: heavy chat preamble then task + compare
gold_orchestration: top action on ControllingObject; then compare to top action on SensingObject
weak_agent_trap: agent reacts to the coffee-machine chat as a task, or misses the real task

title: Worst offender, evidence, fix
gold_orchestration: rank(object_class by fault)->top; counts+top fault; recommend
weak_agent_trap: agent's recommendation references a different component than the one ranked

title: Two questions in one breath
gold_orchestration: P: count(leak)||count(crack); pick max; top_remedy(filter=that fault)
weak_agent_trap: agent answers one of the two, or mis-binds 'the worse one'

title: Long-range callback
intent_mechanism: long-range: 'that component from before' spans 3 turns + a distractor task
gold_orchestration: remember turn-1 component; count(Inspect & that component)
weak_agent_trap: agent forgets the early referent after the unrelated task in between

title: Filter then re-filter
intent_mechanism: coreference: progressive narrowing of one set
gold_orchestration: search(GuidingObject&fault); filter Replace; filter hose subtype
weak_agent_trap: agent restarts the filter from scratch each time instead of narrowing

title: Clarify the unit of count
gold_orchestration: count distinct object_class replaced; then intersect with wear-item set
weak_agent_trap: agent reports WO count not distinct parts; or 'those' rebinds to jobs

title: Parallel compare + casual + extend
instruction_transition: chat then parallel extend then merge
gold_orchestration: P engines:Replace||Repair; P motors; then merge counts
weak_agent_trap: agent treats motors fresh and can't merge with engines for the overall

title: Implicit object
gold_orchestration: find oil-change WOs; infer object; classify activity (Service)
weak_agent_trap: agent treats 'change oil' as Replace, or can't ground 'it'

title: Three-way then pick
instruction_transition: clarification arrives AFTER the compute (must redo)
gold_orchestration: P split among FailedState WOs; argmax; re-scope to failed-only if not already
weak_agent_trap: agent computed over all jobs; the late clarify forces a re-scope it skips

title: Casual misdirection
gold_orchestration: group_count(fault); take rank1 then rank2
weak_agent_trap: agent engages the game chat as if a task, or recomputes for rank2

title: Bad actor -> RCA -> abstain boundary
instruction_transition: clarify lowers the bar from cause to mode
gold_orchestration: rank run-to-failure class; report dominant mode (not fabricated cause)
weak_agent_trap: agent invents a root cause instead of the inferable mode

title: Parallel KPIs for a dashboard
gold_orchestration: P: count||share||share||rank; humanize the component label
weak_agent_trap: agent serialises the 4 (poor path) or mislabels with ontology jargon

title: Refer by position
instruction_transition: positional reference into a prior list
gold_orchestration: rank5; index 3 -> describe; index 5 -> failed-share
weak_agent_trap: agent miscounts ordinals or re-ranks, shifting positions

title: Self-correcting user
gold_orchestration: count(Replace & InfillingObject on pump) vs count(Replace & pump whole)
weak_agent_trap: agent keeps the whole-pump count after the correction

title: Chat that contains a constraint
intent_mechanism: long-range: the 'only faults' constraint set in a chat turn
gold_orchestration: apply fault-only filter from the chat turn; top (activity,object); then group
weak_agent_trap: agent ignores the chat-stated constraint and counts routine work

title: Two sets, then their overlap
instruction_transition: two parallel tasks then an intersection
gold_orchestration: P: setA=failed; setB=replace; |A∩B|
weak_agent_trap: agent recomputes or counts union/either instead of intersection

title: Escalating specificity with chat
gold_orchestration: search(cooling); filter failed; extract remedies
weak_agent_trap: agent loses the cooling scope after the chat turn

title: Compare remedies across two faults
instruction_transition: two parallel asks then a diff
gold_orchestration: P: remedy_dist(leak)||remedy_dist(crack); compare()
weak_agent_trap: agent reports both but never computes the difference asked

title: Long horizon with a casual derail
gold_orchestration: rank3 signatures; for #1 count surface variants
weak_agent_trap: agent re-derives signatures or picks a different one to drill

title: Ambiguous 'it' resolved by context
gold_orchestration: bearing replace vs repair; then same metric on enclosing/housing class
weak_agent_trap: agent mis-resolves 'they/it' or changes the metric

title: Counting with a moving filter
gold_orchestration: count(fault); +ProtectingObject; +Replace
weak_agent_trap: agent treats each turn as independent (loses the stack)

title: Parallel then conditional branch
gold_orchestration: compute share; branch: if>33% rank worst else 'fine'
weak_agent_trap: agent always shows the component (ignores the condition) or mis-evaluates it

title: Re-scope after a wrong assumption
gold_orchestration: pivot from tag to text-derived object_class; rank; top mode
weak_agent_trap: agent persists with the misleading asset tag

title: Terse expert
gold_orchestration: rank replace by class; top3; for #2 group_count(fault)
weak_agent_trap: agent misreads terse commands or wrong ordinal

title: Two metrics, pick by user value
gold_orchestration: P: rank by count || rank by distinct-modes; pick variety winner; list modes
weak_agent_trap: agent answers by count (the obvious) not the variety metric the user chose

title: Inspection -> fix chain, with aside
gold_orchestration: count(Inspect & remedy same WO); group_count(object_class) on that set
weak_agent_trap: agent counts inspect-only or any-remedy, not the conjunction

title: Compare and then combine differently
gold_orchestration: overall split; group by class; argmax reactive share
weak_agent_trap: agent recomputes or ranks by raw reactive count not share

title: Distractor numbers
gold_orchestration: count(<num> token); /total
weak_agent_trap: agent counts digits in text or miscounts the placeholder

title: Multi-component stocking plan
gold_orchestration: P counts 4 items; split failed vs routine; filter+rank failed
weak_agent_trap: agent loses the 4-item scope or mixes planned into the final rank

title: User changes the question after seeing data
instruction_transition: user pivots dimension after seeing results
gold_orchestration: rank components by fault; top; failed-share
weak_agent_trap: agent stays on modes or carries stale numbers

title: Parallel sanity check
gold_orchestration: P: by-object replace || by-activity; assert totals equal
weak_agent_trap: agent doesn't actually cross-check, just restates both

title: Chat reveals scope
intent_mechanism: long-range scope in chat; then user flags it's unsplittable
gold_orchestration: acknowledge no mobile/fixed field; answer overall + caveat
weak_agent_trap: agent fabricates a mobile-only subset

title: Stacked superlatives
gold_orchestration: rank component; its top fault; most-skewed remedy for that fault
weak_agent_trap: agent's chain drifts — final fix not tied to the resolved component/fault

title: Two unrelated tasks then a join
instruction_transition: two tasks then an interpretive follow
gold_orchestration: P: count(Diagnose-only)||count(Replace&!Diagnose); interpret
weak_agent_trap: agent gives raw numbers, never interprets the requested gap

title: Resolve 'the usual' from data
gold_orchestration: modal remedy on SensingObject faults; then condition on FailedState
weak_agent_trap: agent reports a non-modal fix, or ignores the failed-state condition

title: Parallel across three faults + pick
instruction_transition: 3 parallel then a selection by replace-share
gold_orchestration: P: remedy_dist for 3 faults; argmax replace-share
weak_agent_trap: agent picks by raw replace count not share, or drops one fault

title: Long callback after detour
intent_mechanism: long-range callback to valves across a detour task
gold_orchestration: valve top job (remember); DQ count; valve 2nd job
weak_agent_trap: agent loses valve context or recomputes valve set after detour

title: Conditional on data availability
gold_orchestration: detect no dates -> fallback: group_count(fault); flag rank1
weak_agent_trap: agent stalls on the impossible trend instead of taking the offered fallback

title: Build then critique own answer
gold_orchestration: compose headline (top class+mode+reactive%); state its caveat (no time/cost/asset)
weak_agent_trap: agent gives a second headline instead of critiquing the first

title: Everything, prioritised, your call
instruction_transition: open mandate then metric clarify then structured output
gold_orchestration: rank by fault*failed-share; pick; counts as evidence; recommend one task
weak_agent_trap: agent gives a vague theme, or recommends for a component other than the ranked one
